name: Princess of Distortion
source:
Small shadows hide in a hole as big as a wet dream. In this deep sea a woman made of hate and pleasure resides. Follow her in her unchanging day by day while interacting with a graffiti of a time the world was not yet fully connected.

[From [url=https://kooh.itch.io/princess-of-distortion]itch.io[/url]]
